NPC roles, branching dialogue and consequence records

One NPC may offer dialogue, quests, merchant, trainer and crafting services without duplicating player state. Conditions and choices are authored; lasting consequences are validated character records, not booleans hidden in a widget.

Scope and player interaction

One NPC may offer dialogue, quests, merchant, trainer and crafting services without duplicating player state. Conditions and choices are authored; lasting consequences are validated character records, not booleans hidden in a widget.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase15committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Closed → LoadingNode → ShowingText → Choosing → CommandPending → ServiceTransition → OutOfRange → Ended

WBP_Dialogue observes results from URPGDialogueComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Dialogue_Mara. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
NPCDefinitionId: name/localization key, role/service IDs, faction and visual set
DialogueId/NodeId/OptionId: stable IDs, versioned graph
ConditionSet: quest state, reputation threshold, class/profession, flags; read-only evaluation
ChoiceConsequenceId: unique authored operation with repeat/idempotency policy
ConversationNonce: character/NPC/zone/epoch binding and expiry
Text: localization keys and arguments, not hardcoded sentence concatenation

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGDialogueComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DialogueLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
OpenDialogue(InteractionContext) -> NodeView|Unavailable
ChooseDialogueOption(CommandId, Nonce, NodeId, OptionId, ExpectedRevision) -> NextNode|ConditionChanged|CommittedConsequence
OpenNPCService(Nonce, ServiceId) -> AuthorizedContext|NoService
CloseDialogue(Reason) -> Closed; safe local/server cleanup

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player interacts within range/LOS; server resolves NPC roles and current condition facts, returning only available choices and a conversation nonce.
  2. UMG shows localized text/options and stores no authoritative quest/reputation variables.
  3. Player chooses an option ID; server re-evaluates conditions and node/nonce/version, since another action may have changed quest state.
  4. Pure conversation advances without an economic write; a lasting choice uses an idempotent backend command for consequence flags/reputation/reward as defined.
  5. Merchant/trainer/quest/craft option opens the relevant service context; that domain repeats validation for its eventual commit.
  6. Leaving range, NPC despawn, death or travel closes conversation, unbinds UI and invalidates nonce. Late replies from old zone generations are ignored.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create URPGNPCDefinition and URPGDialogueDefinition schemas. Author NPC_Mara as quartermaster/quest giver/vendor and NPC_Tovin as banker/trainer contact with separate service IDs.
  2. Build DA_Dialogue_Mara with greeting, missing-supplies quest offer, in-progress reminder, ready-to-complete and completed nodes; include an optional reputation-sensitive branch.
  3. Create BP_NPC_Mara from ARPGServiceNPC with interaction and sprite presentation but no hostile AI requirement. Static and animated NPCs share service ownership rules.
  4. Build WBP_Dialogue with speaker name, text, option list, close and focus restoration; options are keyed by ID rather than array index alone.
  5. Reopen quest/vendor/trainer components to accept an NPC context and return explicit eligibility reasons; never copy quest inventory into the NPC actor.

Reopen Phase15 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / NPC_Mara / NPC_Tovin / Dialogue_RoadSupplies. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Choice condition changed after screen opened -> ConditionChanged and refreshed node; no unauthorized reward.
Option ID from another dialogue -> InvalidOption.
NPC disappears mid-command -> reversible conversation closes; committed consequence remains and receipt resolves.
Duplicate choice reward packet -> original receipt/AlreadyApplied.
Locale changes with long text -> layout remains usable and choices reachable.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

No voiced dialogue requirement initially. Optional persistent choices should not irreversibly block main progression; provide alternate routes. Day/night schedules are a later world-life feature with service availability fallback.

Audit consequence ID/quest state and reason codes, not unnecessary full dialogue transcripts. Text supports subtitles, scaling, controller navigation and localization keys.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
